name: Folk Lore
description: An expansion of ten commoner classes for the Lastdream setting. Requires Lastdream Core. Adds village-folk classes — Butcher, Blacksmith, Farmer, Librarian, Lumberjack, Apothecary, Carpenter, Innkeeper, Messenger, and Gravedigger — playable from level 0, before any adventuring levels, each with a simple Hope ability grounded in their trade.
